title: searchBox: update the query state when using searchOnEnterKeyPressOnly
body:
When using searchOnEnterKeyPressOnly and willing to bind an external button to trigger a search (like a submit button), this will fail because the search state when clicking on submit will not be the right one.

From http://stackoverflow.com/questions/37101823/how-to-fire-a-search-with-instantsearch-js-when-clicking-on-a-button

This should work.

Also ultimately this will be solved by providing the full form/binding a search button in the searchBox: #1060
